@@ -0,0 +1,425 @@
+// Native ChatGPT transport: immutable candidates only; publication remains the existing governed door.
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto"
+import type { Hash } from "@atlas/contracts"
+import { id } from "@atlas/kernel"
+import type { StoreApi } from "@atlas/kernel"
+import { isOwnershipArtifact, isOwnershipBody, isOwnershipContract, isOwnershipManifest, isOwnershipNeed, isOwnershipReview, readOwnership } from "@atlas/knowledge"
+import type { OwnershipArtifact, OwnershipInput, OwnershipManifest, OwnershipReceipt, OwnershipRefusal, OwnershipResult, OwnershipReview } from "@atlas/knowledge"
+
+type Ref = { readonly commit: string; readonly path: string; readonly sha256: string }
+type Original = { readonly bytes: Uint8Array; readonly sha256: string }
+type Control = { readonly role: "scope" | "criteria" | "contract" | "envelope" | "recipe" | "reviewers" | "previous-layer"; readonly input: OwnershipInput; readonly origin: Ref }
+type Entry = {
+  readonly key: string; readonly title: string; readonly need: OwnershipArtifact["need"]
+  readonly inputs: readonly OwnershipInput[]; readonly dependencies: OwnershipReceipt["dependencies"]
+  readonly navigation: readonly string[]
+}
+
+/** Coordinator-owned: resolve and verify S1/S5 Git refs before constructing this value.
+ * Content hashes prove integrity, not that a reviewer or an authorization actually exists. */
+export interface NativeOwnershipPlan {
+  readonly kind: "ownership-native-plan"; readonly version: 1; readonly campaign: "20261111-v1"
+  readonly scope: string; readonly layer: OwnershipArtifact["layer"]
+  readonly sourceRevision: string; readonly protocolRevision: string; readonly implementationRevision: string
+  readonly controls: readonly Control[]; readonly contract: Hash
+  readonly reviewers: Readonly<Record<"J1" | "J2", { readonly id: string; readonly epoch: string }>>
+  readonly previousManifest: Hash | null; readonly previousImportReceipt: Hash | null
+  readonly entries: readonly Entry[]; readonly requiredKeys: readonly string[]
+  readonly roots: OwnershipManifest["roots"]
+}
+
+/** The original visible request must be JSON with kind/version/plan/key/inputs/dependencies/task.
+ * The response must be JSON with kind/version/requestSha256/key/body/authorityBasis/validity/gaps/evidence.
+ * Store the raw tool receipt separately; it is not replaced by a reconstructed response. */
+export interface NativeOwnershipSubmission {
+  readonly key: string; readonly sessionId: string; readonly agentId: string; readonly attemptId: string
+  readonly request: Original; readonly response: Original; readonly receipt: Original
+}
+
+export interface NativeOwnershipJudgeSubmission {
+  readonly role: "J1" | "J2"; readonly reviewer: string; readonly epoch: string
+  readonly request: Original; readonly response: Original; readonly receipt: Original
+}
+
+type OriginalRefs = { readonly request: Hash; readonly response: Hash; readonly receipt: Hash }
+type Pending = {
+  readonly key: string; readonly result: Hash; readonly inputs: readonly OwnershipInput[]
+  readonly dependencies: OwnershipReceipt["dependencies"]
+  readonly producer: { readonly adapter: "nativeChatGPT"; readonly sessionId: string; readonly agentId: string; readonly attemptId: string }
+  readonly originals: OriginalRefs
+}
+type Candidate = { readonly kind: "ownership-native-candidate"; readonly version: 1; readonly plan: Hash; readonly pending: readonly Pending[] }
+export type NativeOwnershipCandidate = {
+  readonly kind: "candidate"; readonly candidate: Hash; readonly reviewDocument: Hash; readonly reviewedManifestSha256: string
+}
+type Access = {
+  readonly store: StoreApi; readonly current: (key: string) => string | undefined
+  readonly readControlBytes: (key: string) => Uint8Array | undefined
+}
+
+/** No model invocation, publication, projection mutation, policy creation or default approval. */
+export function prepareNativeOwnership(request: Access & {
+  readonly plan: NativeOwnershipPlan; readonly submissions: readonly NativeOwnershipSubmission[]
+}): NativeOwnershipCandidate | OwnershipRefusal {
+  const checked = checkPlan(request)
+  if (checked !== undefined) return checked
+  if (!sameSet(request.submissions.map((submission) => submission.key), request.plan.entries.map((entry) => entry.key)))
+    return hold("ownership-missing", ["native-output-coverage"])
+  const pending: Pending[] = []
+  const plan = put(request.store, request.plan)
+  if (plan === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", ["native-plan-write"])
+  for (const entry of request.plan.entries) {
+    const submission = request.submissions.find((value) => value.key === entry.key)!
+    if (![submission.sessionId, submission.agentId, submission.attemptId].every(text))
+      return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, "native-producer-identity"])
+    const inputs = inputBindings(request.plan, entry)
+    if (inputs === undefined) return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, "conflicting-input-bindings"])
+    const source = checkInputs(inputs, request.current)
+    if (source !== undefined) return source
+    const originals = preserve(request.store, submission)
+    if (originals === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", [entry.key, "native-originals"])
+    const prompt = json(submission.request)
+    if (!object(prompt) || prompt.kind !== "ownership-native-request" || prompt.version !== 1 ||
+      prompt.plan !== plan || prompt.key !== entry.key || !nonempty(prompt.task) ||
+      !inputArray(prompt.inputs) || !dependencyArray(prompt.dependencies) ||
+      id(prompt.inputs) !== id(inputs) || id(prompt.dependencies) !== id(entry.dependencies))
+      return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, "native-request-binding", originals.request])
+    const response = json(submission.response)
+    if (!object(response) || !exact(response, ["kind", "version", "requestSha256", "key", "body", "authorityBasis", "validity", "gaps", "evidence"]) ||
+      response.kind !== "ownership-native-response" || response.version !== 1 || response.requestSha256 !== submission.request.sha256 ||
+      response.key !== entry.key || !nonempty(response.body) || !text(response.authorityBasis) ||
+      !strings(response.gaps) || !strings(response.evidence) || !["supported", "blocked"].includes(String(response.validity)))
+      return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, "native-response-binding", originals.response])
+    if (response.validity === "blocked") return hold("ownership-blocked", [entry.key, ...response.gaps, originals.response])
+    const bodyBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(response.body)
+    if (new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true, ignoreBOM: true }).decode(bodyBytes) !== response.body)
+      return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, "native-body-unicode"])
+    const transport = json(submission.receipt)
+    if (!object(transport) || transport.kind !== "ownership-native-transport-receipt" || transport.version !== 1 ||
+      transport.adapter !== "nativeChatGPT" || transport.campaign !== request.plan.campaign || transport.completion !== "COMPLETED" ||
+      transport.sessionId !== submission.sessionId || transport.agentId !== submission.agentId || transport.attemptId !== submission.attemptId ||
+      transport.requestSha256 !== submission.request.sha256 || transport.responseSha256 !== submission.response.sha256 || !reference(transport.reservation))
+      return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, "native-producer-receipt-binding"])
+    const body = put(request.store, { kind: "ownership-body", version: 1, bytes: Array.from(bodyBytes) })
+    if (body === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", [entry.key, "native-body-write"])
+    const result: OwnershipResult = {
+      kind: "ownership-result", version: 1, body,
+      authority: { scope: request.plan.scope, basis: response.authorityBasis }, validity: "supported",
+      gaps: response.gaps, evidence: response.evidence,
+    }
+    const resultRef = put(request.store, result)
+    if (resultRef === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", [entry.key, "native-result-write"])
+    pending.push({
+      key: entry.key, result: resultRef, inputs, dependencies: entry.dependencies,
+      producer: { adapter: "nativeChatGPT", sessionId: submission.sessionId, agentId: submission.agentId, attemptId: submission.attemptId }, originals,
+    })
+  }
+  const after = checkPlan(request)
+  if (after !== undefined) return after
+  const candidate: Candidate = { kind: "ownership-native-candidate", version: 1, plan, pending }
+  const candidateRef = put(request.store, candidate)
+  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(candidate, null, 2) + "\n")
+  const reviewDocument = put(request.store, { kind: "ownership-body", version: 1, bytes: Array.from(bytes) })
+  if (candidateRef === undefined || reviewDocument === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", ["native-candidate-write"])
+  return { kind: "candidate", candidate: candidateRef, reviewDocument, reviewedManifestSha256: sha256(bytes) }
+}
+
+/** Converts two ORIGINAL S5 PASS decisions into existing ownership reviews, never into host authority.
+ * Caller must preserve failed/HOLD originals too. A private candidate is not a published read. */
+export function bindNativeOwnershipReviews(request: Access & {
+  readonly plan: NativeOwnershipPlan; readonly candidate: NativeOwnershipCandidate
+  readonly reviews: readonly NativeOwnershipJudgeSubmission[]
+}): OwnershipRefusal | { readonly kind: "candidate"; readonly manifest: Hash; readonly importReceipt: Hash } {
+  const checked = checkPlan(request)
+  if (checked !== undefined) return checked
+  const candidate = request.store.get(request.candidate.candidate)
+  const document = request.store.get(request.candidate.reviewDocument)
+  if (!object(candidate) || !exact(candidate, ["kind", "version", "plan", "pending"]) || candidate.kind !== "ownership-native-candidate" || candidate.version !== 1 ||
+    candidate.plan !== id(request.plan) || !Array.isArray(candidate.pending) || !matchesIdentity(candidate, request.candidate.candidate) ||
+    !isOwnershipBody(document) || id(document) !== request.candidate.reviewDocument ||
+    sha256(new Uint8Array(document.bytes)) !== request.candidate.reviewedManifestSha256 ||
+    !sameData(json({ bytes: new Uint8Array(document.bytes), sha256: request.candidate.reviewedManifestSha256 }), candidate))
+    return hold("ownership-integrity", ["native-review-document"])
+  const pending = candidate.pending
+  if (!pending.every(object) || !sameSet(pending.map((entry) => String(entry.key)), request.plan.entries.map((entry) => entry.key)))
+    return hold("malformed-ownership", ["native-candidate-coverage"])
+  const submissions: NativeOwnershipSubmission[] = []
+  for (const entry of pending) {
+    if (!text(entry.key) || !object(entry.producer) || entry.producer.adapter !== "nativeChatGPT" ||
+      !text(entry.producer.sessionId) || !text(entry.producer.agentId) || !text(entry.producer.attemptId) || !object(entry.originals))
+      return hold("malformed-ownership", ["native-producer-identity"])
+    const rawRefs = entry.originals
+    const original = (name: string): Original | undefined => {
+      const ref = rawRefs[name]
+      if (!hash(ref)) return undefined
+      const value = request.store.get(ref)
+      if (!isOwnershipBody(value) || id(value) !== ref) return undefined
+      const bytes = new Uint8Array(value.bytes)
+      return { bytes, sha256: sha256(bytes) }
+    }
+    const prompt = original("request")
+    const response = original("response")
+    const receipt = original("receipt")
+    if (prompt === undefined || response === undefined || receipt === undefined) return hold("ownership-missing", [entry.key, "native-originals"])
+    submissions.push({ key: entry.key, sessionId: entry.producer.sessionId, agentId: entry.producer.agentId, attemptId: entry.producer.attemptId, request: prompt, response, receipt })
+  }
+  // Deterministic validation replay of preserved bytes, never a new producer/model request.
+  const rebuilt = prepareNativeOwnership({ ...request, submissions })
+  if (rebuilt.kind === "hold") return rebuilt
+  if (rebuilt.candidate !== request.candidate.candidate || rebuilt.reviewedManifestSha256 !== request.candidate.reviewedManifestSha256)
+    return hold("ownership-integrity", ["native-original-result-binding"])
+  if (!sameSet(request.reviews.map((review) => review.role), ["J1", "J2"]))
+    return hold("ownership-review", ["native-reviewer-pair"])
+  const contract = request.store.get(request.plan.contract)
+  if (!isOwnershipContract(contract) || id(contract) !== request.plan.contract)
+    return hold("ownership-review", ["native-contract"])
+  const originals: { role: "J1" | "J2"; reviewer: string; epoch: string; refs: OriginalRefs }[] = []
+  for (const review of request.reviews) {
+    const appointed = request.plan.reviewers[review.role]
+    const refs = preserve(request.store, review)
+    if (refs === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", ["native-review-originals", review.role])
+    const prompt = json(review.request)
+    const decision = json(review.response)
+    if (review.reviewer !== appointed.id || review.epoch !== appointed.epoch ||
+      !object(prompt) || prompt.kind !== "ownership-native-judge-request" || prompt.version !== 1 ||
+      prompt.campaign !== request.plan.campaign || prompt.judge_role !== review.role || prompt.reviewer !== appointed.id || prompt.epoch !== appointed.epoch ||
+      prompt.reviewed_manifest_sha256 !== request.candidate.reviewedManifestSha256 || prompt.candidate_revision !== request.plan.implementationRevision ||
+      !object(decision) || !exact(decision, ["campaign", "judge_role", "reviewed_manifest_sha256", "candidate_revision", "decision", "criteria", "critical_findings", "permitted_unknowns", "optional_suggestions"]) ||
+      decision.campaign !== request.plan.campaign || decision.judge_role !== review.role ||
+      decision.reviewed_manifest_sha256 !== request.candidate.reviewedManifestSha256 ||
+      decision.candidate_revision !== request.plan.implementationRevision || decision.decision !== "PASS" ||
+      !Array.isArray(decision.criteria) || !decision.criteria.every(object) ||
+      !sameSet(decision.criteria.map((criterion) => String(criterion.id)), contract.criteria) ||
+      decision.criteria.some((criterion) => criterion.verdict !== "PASS" || !text(criterion.id) || !nonempty(criterion.reason) || !strings(criterion.evidence) || criterion.evidence.length === 0) ||
+      !Array.isArray(decision.critical_findings) || decision.critical_findings.length !== 0 || !Array.isArray(decision.permitted_unknowns) || !Array.isArray(decision.optional_suggestions))
+      return hold("ownership-review", ["native-decision", review.role, refs.response])
+    const transport = json(review.receipt)
+    if (!object(transport) || transport.kind !== "ownership-native-transport-receipt" || transport.version !== 1 ||
+      transport.adapter !== "nativeChatGPT" || transport.campaign !== request.plan.campaign || transport.completion !== "COMPLETED" ||
+      transport.agentId !== appointed.id || transport.epoch !== appointed.epoch || transport.requestSha256 !== review.request.sha256 ||
+      transport.responseSha256 !== review.response.sha256 || !text(transport.sessionId) || !text(transport.attemptId) || !reference(transport.reservation))
+      return hold("ownership-review", ["native-judge-receipt-binding", review.role])
+    originals.push({ role: review.role, reviewer: review.reviewer, epoch: review.epoch, refs })
+  }
+  const previous = request.plan.previousManifest === null ? undefined : request.store.get(request.plan.previousManifest)
+  const entries: { key: string; artifact: Hash }[] = isOwnershipManifest(previous) ? [...previous.entries] : []
+  for (const entry of request.plan.entries) {
+    const produced = pending.find((value) => value.key === entry.key)!
+    const inputs = inputBindings(request.plan, entry)
+    if (inputs === undefined || !inputArray(produced.inputs) || !dependencyArray(produced.dependencies) || id(produced.inputs) !== id(inputs) || id(produced.dependencies) !== id(entry.dependencies) ||
+      !hash(produced.result) || !object(produced.originals) || !object(produced.producer) || produced.producer.adapter !== "nativeChatGPT")
+      return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, "native-pending-binding"])
+    for (const name of ["request", "response", "receipt"] as const) {
+      const ref = produced.originals[name]
+      if (!hash(ref)) return hold("ownership-missing", [entry.key, name])
+      const value = request.store.get(ref)
+      if (!isOwnershipBody(value) || id(value) !== ref) return hold("ownership-integrity", [entry.key, name])
+    }
+    const reviews: Hash[] = []
+    for (const original of originals) {
+      const review: OwnershipReview = {
+        kind: "ownership-review", version: 1, reviewer: original.reviewer,
+        contract: request.plan.contract, inputs: id({ inputs, dependencies: entry.dependencies }), result: produced.result,
+        criteria: contract.criteria, verdict: "pass",
+        provenance: `nativeChatGPT ${original.role} epoch ${original.epoch}; candidate ${request.candidate.candidate}; original request ${original.refs.request}; original decision ${original.refs.response}; host receipt ${original.refs.receipt}`,
+      }
+      const reviewRef = put(request.store, review)
+      if (reviewRef === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", [entry.key, "native-review-write"])
+      reviews.push(reviewRef)
+    }
+    const receipt: OwnershipReceipt = { kind: "ownership-receipt", version: 1, contract: request.plan.contract, inputs, dependencies: entry.dependencies, reviews }
+    const receiptRef = put(request.store, receipt)
+    if (receiptRef === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", [entry.key, "native-receipt-write"])
+    const artifact: OwnershipArtifact = {
+      kind: "ownership-artifact", version: 1, key: entry.key, scope: request.plan.scope, title: entry.title,
+      layer: request.plan.layer, need: entry.need, result: produced.result, receipt: receiptRef, navigation: entry.navigation,
+    }
+    const artifactRef = put(request.store, artifact)
+    if (artifactRef === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", [entry.key, "native-artifact-write"])
+    entries.push({ key: entry.key, artifact: artifactRef })
+  }
+  const manifest: OwnershipManifest = { kind: "ownership-manifest", version: 1, scope: request.plan.scope, entries, roots: request.plan.roots }
+  const manifestRef = put(request.store, manifest)
+  if (manifestRef === undefined) return hold("ownership-integrity", ["native-manifest-write"])
+  for (const entry of entries) {
+    const read = readOwnership(request.store, manifestRef, { scope: request.plan.scope, key: entry.key, maxBytes: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }, request.current)
+    if (read.kind === "hold") return read
+  }
+  for (const need of Object.keys(manifest.roots)) {
+    const read = readOwnership(request.store, manifestRef, { scope: request.plan.scope, need: need as keyof typeof manifest.roots, maxBytes: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }, request.current)
+    if (read.kind === "hold") return read
+  }
+  const after = checkPlan(request)
+  if (after !== undefined) return after
+  const importReceipt = put(request.store, {
+    kind: "ownership-native-import-receipt", version: 1, plan: id(request.plan), candidate: request.candidate.candidate,
+    reviewDocument: request.candidate.reviewDocument, manifest: manifestRef, originals,
+  })
+  return importReceipt === undefined ? hold("ownership-integrity", ["native-import-receipt-write"]) : { kind: "candidate", manifest: manifestRef, importReceipt }
+}
+
+function checkPlan(request: Access & { readonly plan: NativeOwnershipPlan }): OwnershipRefusal | undefined {
+  const plan = request.plan
+  if (!isNativeOwnershipPlan(plan) || !sameSet(plan.requiredKeys, plan.requiredKeys) || plan.requiredKeys.length === 0 ||
+    !sameSet(plan.entries.map((entry) => entry.key), plan.entries.map((entry) => entry.key)))
+    return hold("malformed-ownership", ["native-plan"])
+  const roles = plan.controls.map((control) => control.role)
+  if (!sameSet(roles, plan.layer === 1 ? ["scope", "criteria", "contract", "envelope", "recipe", "reviewers"] : ["scope", "criteria", "contract", "envelope", "recipe", "reviewers", "previous-layer"]) ||
+    plan.controls.some((control) => !/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(control.origin.commit) || !text(control.origin.path) || !hash(control.origin.sha256)) ||
+    ![plan.reviewers.J1.id, plan.reviewers.J1.epoch, plan.reviewers.J2.id, plan.reviewers.J2.epoch].every(text) || plan.reviewers.J1.id === plan.reviewers.J2.id)
+    return hold("ownership-review", ["native-frozen-controls"])
+  const controlCheck = checkInputs(plan.controls.map((control) => control.input), request.current)
+  if (controlCheck !== undefined) return controlCheck
+  const contract = request.store.get(plan.contract)
+  if (!isOwnershipContract(contract) || id(contract) !== plan.contract) return hold("ownership-review", ["native-contract"])
+  for (const control of plan.controls) {
+    if (control.input.key !== `file:${control.origin.path}`) return hold("malformed-ownership", ["native-control-path", control.role])
+    const bytes = request.readControlBytes(control.input.key)
+    if (bytes === undefined) return hold("ownership-input-unavailable", [control.input.key])
+    if (sha256(bytes) !== control.origin.sha256 || id({ kind: "ownership-source", version: 1, bytes: Array.from(bytes) }) !== control.input.version)
+      return hold("ownership-input-changed", [control.input.key])
+    const value = json({ bytes, sha256: control.origin.sha256 })
+    if (control.role === "scope" && (!object(value) || value.kind !== "ownership-native-scope" || value.version !== 1 ||
+      value.campaign !== plan.campaign || value.scope !== plan.scope || value.layer !== plan.layer ||
+      value.sourceRevision !== plan.sourceRevision || value.protocolRevision !== plan.protocolRevision ||
+      !sameData(value.requiredKeys, plan.requiredKeys) || !sameData(value.entries, plan.entries) || !sameData(value.roots, plan.roots)))
+      return hold("ownership-scope", ["native-frozen-scope-control"])
+    if (control.role === "contract" && (!isOwnershipContract(value) || id(value) !== plan.contract))
+      return hold("ownership-review", ["native-contract-control"])
+    if (control.role === "reviewers" && (!object(value) || value.kind !== "ownership-native-reviewers" || value.version !== 1 ||
+      value.campaign !== plan.campaign || !sameData(value.reviewers, plan.reviewers)))
+      return hold("ownership-review", ["native-reviewer-roster-control"])
+    if (control.role === "previous-layer" && (!object(value) || value.kind !== "ownership-native-layer-acceptance" || value.version !== 1 ||
+      value.campaign !== plan.campaign || value.scope !== plan.scope || value.layer !== plan.layer - 1 || value.manifest !== plan.previousManifest ||
+      value.importReceipt !== plan.previousImportReceipt || value.decision !== "ACCEPTED_SCOPED" || !sameData(value.reviewers, plan.reviewers)))
+      return hold("ownership-review", ["native-previous-layer-acceptance"])
+  }
+  const previous = plan.previousManifest === null ? undefined : request.store.get(plan.previousManifest)
+  if ((plan.layer === 1) !== (plan.previousManifest === null) || (plan.layer === 1) !== (plan.previousImportReceipt === null))
+    return hold("ownership-review", ["native-previous-layer"])
+  if (plan.previousManifest !== null && (!isOwnershipManifest(previous) || id(previous) !== plan.previousManifest || previous.scope !== plan.scope))
+    return hold("ownership-integrity", ["native-previous-manifest"])
+  const prior = isOwnershipManifest(previous) ? previous.entries : []
+  if (plan.previousImportReceipt !== null) {
+    const receipt = request.store.get(plan.previousImportReceipt)
+    if (!object(receipt) || receipt.kind !== "ownership-native-import-receipt" || receipt.version !== 1 ||
+      !matchesIdentity(receipt, plan.previousImportReceipt) || receipt.manifest !== plan.previousManifest || !Array.isArray(receipt.originals) ||
+      !receipt.originals.every(object) || !sameSet(receipt.originals.map((value) => String(value.role)), ["J1", "J2"]) ||
+      receipt.originals.some((value) => value.role !== "J1" && value.role !== "J2" ||
+        value.reviewer !== plan.reviewers[value.role as "J1" | "J2"].id || value.epoch !== plan.reviewers[value.role as "J1" | "J2"].epoch))
+      return hold("ownership-review", ["native-previous-import-receipt"])
+  }
+  if (!sameSet([...prior.map((entry) => entry.key), ...plan.entries.map((entry) => entry.key)], plan.requiredKeys))
+    return hold("ownership-missing", ["native-required-coverage"])
+  for (const old of prior) {
+    const artifact = request.store.get(old.artifact)
+    if (!isOwnershipArtifact(artifact) || artifact.layer >= plan.layer) return hold("ownership-review", [old.key, "native-layer-order"])
+    const read = readOwnership(request.store, plan.previousManifest!, { scope: plan.scope, key: old.key, maxBytes: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER }, request.current)
+    if (read.kind === "hold") return read
+    const receipt = request.store.get(read.receipt)
+    if (!object(receipt) || !Array.isArray(receipt.reviews)) return hold("ownership-review", [old.key])
+    const reviewers = receipt.reviews.map((ref) => hash(ref) ? request.store.get(ref) : undefined)
+    if (!reviewers.every(isOwnershipReview) || !sameSet(reviewers.map((review) => review.reviewer), [plan.reviewers.J1.id, plan.reviewers.J2.id]))
+      return hold("ownership-review", [old.key, "native-previous-reviewers"])
+  }
+  for (const entry of plan.entries) {
+    const inputs = inputBindings(plan, entry)
+    if (!text(entry.key) || !text(entry.title) || inputs === undefined || !strings(entry.navigation) || !sameSet(entry.navigation, entry.navigation))
+      return hold("malformed-ownership", [entry.key, "native-entry"])
+    const current = checkInputs(inputs, request.current)
+    if (current !== undefined) return current
+    for (const dependency of entry.dependencies) {
+      const ref = prior.find((old) => old.key === dependency.key)?.artifact
+      const artifact = ref === undefined ? undefined : request.store.get(ref)
+      if (!isOwnershipArtifact(artifact) || artifact.result !== dependency.result)
+        return hold("ownership-dependency-changed", [entry.key, dependency.key])
